## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete user/operator problem and the resulting behavior.

## Validation

Identify the exact checks and their outcomes. Separate fixture, real-image,
external-provider and manual evidence. State when required local verification
is still pending; do not infer it from a source build or a previous commit.

## Deployment and remaining limits

Describe data/schema compatibility, recovery and any unverified capabilities.
For source-only changes, say that publication does not deploy the running service.
